name: Smashing Magazine
summary: Magazine with practical articles, books and workshops on CSS, JavaScript, accessibility, UX and design.
description: Independent publication founded in 2006 for web designers and developers. Articles run under topic categories (CSS, UX, accessibility, JavaScript, performance, React, Vue, Figma …) alongside printed books and eBooks, online workshops, a membership community and a weekly newsletter.
contains: articles across CSS, UX, accessibility, JavaScript, performance, React, Vue and Figma
online workshops in 2.5h live segments with recordings
membership community and weekly newsletter, 182,000+ subscribers
